rules.title: Every route requires login
rules.description: Every Flask route in app/routes.py must be wrapped in @login_required.

rules.title: Parameterized SQL only
rules.description: SQL must use ? placeholders; never build queries with f-strings or string concatenation.

rules.title: List endpoints are bounded
rules.description: Endpoints that return lists must apply a LIMIT so one request cannot load the whole table.

rules.title: Database access through get_db
rules.description: Open SQLite connections only via app.db.get_db, never sqlite3.connect directly.
